examples.trans: We need to do even more.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.

examples.text: Аракелян просит время. Сумма очень большая.
examples.trans: Arakelyan is asking for more time. The sum is very large.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

вернуть.gloss: to give back, to get back

examples.text: Ты эти деньги через полгода вернёшь.
examples.trans: You'll get this money back in six months.

возвращать.gloss: to return, to give back, to bring back

meanings.en: to return, to give back, to bring back
meanings.note: возвращать долг = to pay back a debt

examples.text: Нет, спасибо, отца возвращать не надо.
examples.trans: No, thanks, there's no need to bring Dad back.

examples.text: Я возвращаю в ресторан старое меню.
examples.trans: I'm bringing the old menu back to the restaurant.

examples.text: Не надо врать. Стену монастыря сносят!
examples.trans: Don't lie. They're pulling down the monastery wall!
She's offended. She's always like that.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

выпить.gloss: to drink (up); to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink of

examples.trans: May I drink a tiny drop of beer?

examples.text: Милый, можно я выпью капельку пива?
examples.trans: Darling, may I drink a tiny drop of beer?

related.gloss: to go on a drinking binge

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)
emphatic at the start of a sentence
+ dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

meanings.en: to agree, to come to an arrangement

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.trans: Afterwards I'll drive you back for free.

examples.text: Вот это дело! Потом обратно бесплатно отвезу.
examples.trans: Now we're talking! Afterwards I'll drive you back for free.

examples.text: Государство обязательно увидит и назначит операцию.
examples.trans: The state will surely see and will schedule the surgery.
I'll definitely buy you a tank.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

meanings.note: Остаётся у нас = stays with us.

examples.trans: And the advance stays with us.

meanings.note: Done in response to an action.

examples.text: Ну, теперь жду вас к себе с ответным визитом.
examples.trans: Well, now I'm expecting you to pay me a return visit.

examples.text: Тогда у меня есть ответная просьба.
examples.trans: Then I have a request in return.

meanings.note: fleeting е in all declined forms: отца, отцу...

examples.text: Твой отец когда-то назвал меня очкариком.
examples.trans: Your father once called me four-eyes.
My father works at a factory.

examples.text: Слушай, эти детские клички такие прилипчивые. Твой отец когда-то назвал меня очкариком.
examples.trans: Listen, these childhood nicknames really stick. Your father once called me four-eyes.

meanings.en: to continue, last, remain in progress

examples.trans: Calm down, the special operation continues.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness

examples.trans: When I grow up, you'll be begging me to forgive you!

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: у нас к вам просьба = we have a request for you

examples.trans: We have a request for you.

examples.text: У меня к тебе маленькая просьба.
examples.trans: I have a small favour to ask of you.

examples.text: Добрый вечер! У нас к вам просьба.
examples.trans: Good evening! We have a request for you.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?
